title: 第5章 瑟薇娅的筹备第6章 洛加里斯的准备
slug: 军事公主不会爱上魔法科学家
lines: 一旦说出预言的事，他会死。
事情越来越扑朔迷离了。
该死。
洛加里斯深吸了口气，勉强压下心中的躁动。
预言书的来历，比他想象的更加神秘。
他把手插进口袋里，摸到那本书的封皮。冰凉的触感让他更加清醒。
七天。
他必须自己找到答案。
洛加里斯戴上眼镜，加快脚步往前走。
夜色很深，街道空荡荡的。
他走了几条街，身后突然传来一阵脚步声。
“洛加里斯教授。”
一个声音突然响起。
洛加里斯停下脚步，没有回头。
“真是没想到，深夜在这里还能遇到大名鼎鼎的洛加里斯教授。”
声音里带着笑意，但洛加里斯听出了试探。
他转过身。
巷子口站着一个穿着华丽礼服的中年男人，身后跟着几个护卫。
克劳德子爵，二皇子的谋士。
洛加里斯的思绪飞速转动。
克劳德笑着走过来：“教授这么聪明的人，应该看得出来。王国现在的局势，很不稳定。二皇子殿下非常欣赏您的才华，如果您愿意——”
洛加里斯打断他，语气很平淡，但眼睛里没有任何温度。
克劳德的言语带着一丝恼怒：“洛加里斯，你不要——”
但洛加里斯没有多余的话，转身就自顾自地往前走，消失在街道的转角。
直到身后传来克劳德咬牙切齿的声音：“不知好歹的东西！”
第二天。
瑟薇娅站在书房里，面前摆着一张北境的详细地图。
地图上密密麻麻标注着各种符号。
“殿下。”
艾琳娜推门进来，手里抱着一摞文件。
“这是您要的人员名单。”
瑟薇娅接过文件，快速翻阅。
第一份是护卫队名单。
三十个人，全是她本人的心腹。
这批卫队每个人都配备了洛加里斯设计的最新型魔导装甲。
据洛加里斯本人所说，这套魔导装甲内置了多道符文术式，且相关技术完全没有公布在任何论文和期刊上。
content_en:
Once he says what is prophesied, he will die.
Things are getting more and more confusing.
Damn it.
Logaris took a deep breath and managed to suppress the restlessness in his heart.
The origin of the prophecy was more mysterious than he imagined.
He put his hand in his pocket and felt the cover of the book. The cold touch made him more awake.
seven days.
He must find the answer himself.
Logaris put on his glasses and walked forward faster.
The night was dark and the streets were deserted.
He walked a few streets when suddenly there was a sound of footsteps behind him.
"Professor Logaris."
A voice suddenly sounded.
Logaris stopped and did not look back.
"I really didn't expect to meet the famous Professor Logaris here late at night."
There was a smile in his voice, but Logaris heard the temptation.
He turned around.
Standing at the entrance of the alley was a middle-aged man in a gorgeous dress, followed by several guards.
Viscount Claude, the counselor of the second prince.
Logaris's thoughts were racing.
Claude walked over with a smile: "A smart person like the professor should be able to see that. The current situation in the kingdom is very unstable. His Royal Highness the Second Prince appreciates your talent very much. If you are willing-"
"Get lost."
Logaris interrupted him, his tone was very calm, but there was no warmth in his eyes.
Claude's words were filled with anger: "Logaris, don't—"
But Logaris didn't have any extra words to say. He turned around and walked forward on his own, disappearing around the corner of the street.
Until the voice of Claude gnashing his teeth came from behind: "You ungrateful thing!"
...
The next day.
Serviya stood in the study room with a detailed map of the North in front of her.
The map is densely marked with various symbols.
"Your Highness."
Elena pushed the door open and came in, holding a stack of documents in her hand.
"Here's the list of people you want."
Serviya took the file and flipped through it quickly.
The first is the list of escorts.
Thirty people, all her confidants.
Each of these guards is equipped with the latest magic armor designed by Logaris.
According to Logaris himself, this set of magical armor has multiple runes built into it, and the related technology has not been published in any papers or journals at all.
